detail.problem: Three parts, all present: (1) sexual assault/rape = Victim of forced sexual activity (exists; child of Victim of sexual abuse), (2) within last 5 days if woman = (and Female (<= (onset ...) (time_ago 5 days))), (3) within last 3 days if man = (and Male (<= (onset ...) (time_ago 3 days))). Direction follows the briefing convention ('<' time_ago N = within the last N).
